summary: Enable Usage Insights (beta) feature flag for AcmeAI enterprise eval workspace
description:
Requester (SE): Evan Scott (Solutions Engineering)
Account: AcmeAI (enterprise eval)
Workspace: acmeai-enterprise-eval
Workspace ID: ws_7K2Q9M3P
Org ID: org_2J8D4R
Primary contact: Avery Johnson (AE)
Region: us-east (hosted)

Request
Please enable the new Console feature: Usage/Cost → “Usage Insights (Beta)” for the AcmeAI eval workspace.

Why / customer context
AcmeAI is evaluating Redwood primarily for cost transparency. They requested route + model breakdown and CSV export for finance workflows. They are OK with beta limitations as long as totals reconcile with billing within tolerance and exports are permission-gated.

Requested scope
- Enable feature flag / allowlist for workspace: ws_7K2Q9M3P
- Ensure cost views + export are only available to workspace users with appropriate role (Owner/Admin + Cost Viewer if applicable)
- Confirm audit events are emitted for export generation + downloads

Approvals needed (per beta checklist)
- Product approval: Marissa Cole / Paula Mendes
- Security approval (exports + audit logging): Marcus Lin / Kevin Osei
- Support readiness: Dev Patel (known issues acknowledged)

Notes / constraints
- Customer has strict reconciliation expectations. If we see drift vs invoice > 1% over 24h, disable beta and notify SE/AE.
- Customer wants 30-day view; if timeouts occur, advise 7-day and exports.

Enablement checklist
[ ] Confirm customer understands beta limitations / known issues
[ ] Confirm workspace has correct RBAC roles set (who can view cost)
[ ] Enable feature flag for workspace
[ ] Verify the Console renders Usage Insights page and loads breakdown table
[ ] Verify export action appears only for allowed roles
[ ] Verify export emits audit log events (generate + download)
[ ] Post-enable monitoring: freshness banner, query p95, reconciliation drift

Links
- HubSpot: company-acmeai-enterprise-eval
- Email thread: gmail/avery_johnson/20260112-usage-insights-beta-invite-and-success-criteria
- Slack: #eng-releases thread 1738618900 (beta rollout checklist)
- Slack: #eng-security thread 1738269006 (export audit log fields)
comments: 2026-01-16 09:18 Evan Scott (Reporter): Requesting enablement for AcmeAI eval (ws_7K2Q9M3P). Avery has customer on a call next week and wants to demo route+model breakdown + export. Customer understands this is beta. Please confirm approvals needed and proceed.

2026-01-16 09:42 Connor O'Brien (Assignee): Acknowledged. Looping in Product + Security for explicit OK since this includes exports. @Marissa Cole / @Paula Mendes can you confirm AcmeAI is on the beta allowlist? @Marcus Lin / @Kevin Osei please confirm export audit logging fields are in place for this enablement.

2026-01-16 10:05 Paula Mendes: Product OK to enable for AcmeAI. They’re listed as a priority eval in the beta customer list. Please ensure they’re on latest build with freshness banner and reconciliation checks.

2026-01-16 10:22 Kevin Osei: Security OK provided that (1) cost visibility is role-gated, (2) export generation + download emit audit events with workspace_id, actor_id, export_id, and signed_url expiry, and (3) restricted workspaces are not enabled. AcmeAI is not restricted; proceed.

2026-01-16 11:03 Connor O'Brien: Confirmed RBAC settings: workspace setting “Hide cost” is OFF; roles reviewed with SE. Proceeding with enablement under feature flag `console.usage_insights.beta` (workspace allowlist).

2026-01-16 11:27 Connor O'Brien: Enabled `console.usage_insights.beta` for ws_7K2Q9M3P in prod. Verified in Console (admin account) that Usage Insights page loads and breakdown table returns data for last 7 days. 30-day range is slower but completes; advised SE to start with 7-day for live demos.

2026-01-16 11:41 Connor O'Brien: Export verification: as Owner role, export job completes and signed download URL generated. As Member role without cost permission, page shows permission message and export button is hidden. Audit log events observed: `usage_insights_export_created` and `usage_insights_export_downloaded` (fields present: workspace_id, actor_id, export_id).

2026-01-16 12:10 Dev Patel: Support readiness note—known issues include (a) possible invoice mismatch due to late events and rounding over short windows, and (b) timeouts on 30-day interactive queries; recommend export for larger windows. If AcmeAI reports mismatch, open SUP ticket and link back here.
2026-01-17 09:02 Evan Scott: Confirmed enabled on our side; we can see the page and export. Thanks. We’ll monitor for reconciliation drift after customer traffic ramps.

2026-01-17 09:20 Connor O'Brien: Closing as resolved. Monitoring for 7 days: freshness lag banner, query timeouts, and reconciliation drift. If drift > 1% persists, we’ll disable flag and escalate to Console Backend + Billing hooks owners.
resolution: Enabled Usage Insights (Beta) feature flag for AcmeAI eval workspace (ws_7K2Q9M3P) in prod. Verified RBAC gating, export behavior, and audit logging events. Customer demo-ready; monitoring plan noted.
